articles.title: Bitcoin little changed, DeFi tokens lead the bounce as U.S. marks Thanksgiving
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is holding near $60,800 after rebounding from Wednesday's $57,500 low, while DeFi and infrastructure tokens are gaining nearly twice as much.

articles.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
articles.snippet: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

articles.title: Zcash developers want to phase out older privacy system as a precaution against future attacks
articles.snippet: Zakura is pushing to stop new payments into Sapling sooner, citing the possibility that AI-assisted discoveries could weaken the math protecting it.

articles.title: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos set to become next ECB president: FT
articles.snippet: The Spanish economist has questioned the viability of stablecoins for widespread payments while backing the development of a digital euro.

articles.title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
articles.snippet: Sky’s Core Facilitator invoked the protocol’s emergency response process to expedite a vote rather than wait until the next scheduled vote on Dec. 3.
